description: 人工标注语义评估集（成员 B 冻结）。每条 pair 含两条 NewsRecord 与 same_event 标签。日期依据真实事件检索核实；same_event=true 表示两条记录描述同一具体现实事件（同一合并/和解/灾害/召回/政府行动/决定），false 表示各自独立事件。标注规则冻结于 docs/architecture/evaluation-table.md §2。

records.title: AMD to acquire Xilinx in $35 billion all-stock deal
records.snippet: Advanced Micro Devices announced it will acquire Xilinx for $35 billion in stock, combining its CPU business with Xilinx's FPGA products.

records.title: Xilinx shareholders to receive 1.7234 AMD shares per share under merger
records.snippet: Xilinx confirmed the all-stock acquisition by AMD, valuing Xilinx at $35 billion; the deal closed in February 2022.

records.title: Visa reaches $38 billion swipe-fee settlement with US merchants
records.snippet: Visa reached a revised settlement with merchants to lower credit card swipe fees charged to businesses.

records.title: Mastercard joins Visa in revised swipe-fee settlement with merchants
records.snippet: Mastercard agreed to the same revised merchant settlement framework, cutting interchange fees alongside Visa.

records.title: Apple supplier TSMC hit by Taiwan earthquake, chip output affected
records.snippet: A magnitude 7.2 earthquake struck Taiwan's eastern coast near Hualien, prompting TSMC to evacuate fabs and disrupting chip production.

records.title: Nvidia flags GPU supply disruption from same Taiwan earthquake
records.snippet: Nvidia said the same Taiwan earthquake that hit TSMC would tighten supply of its data-center GPUs.

records.title: JPMorgan lifts net-interest outlook after Fed's 50bp rate cut
records.snippet: JPMorgan raised its full-year net interest income forecast, citing the Federal Reserve's 50 basis point rate cut announced Wednesday.

records.title: Goldman Sachs revises lending forecasts following Fed rate cut
records.snippet: Goldman Sachs updated its loan and trading revenue forecasts in response to the same Federal Reserve rate cut.

records.title: Delta cancels hundreds of flights amid CrowdStrike software outage
records.snippet: Delta Air Lines grounded hundreds of flights after a faulty CrowdStrike software update triggered a global IT outage.

records.title: United Airlines grounds departures in same CrowdStrike IT outage
records.snippet: United Airlines suspended departures as the same CrowdStrike-related outage affected its operations.

records.title: Pfizer reports combined COVID-flu vaccine Phase 3 top-line results
records.snippet: Pfizer said its combined COVID-19 and influenza vaccine met COVID-19 and influenza A endpoints but missed the influenza B endpoint in a Phase 3 trial with BioNTech.

records.title: BioNTech announces Phase 3 results for joint COVID-flu vaccine with Pfizer
records.snippet: BioNTech reported top-line Phase 3 data for the same combined COVID-flu vaccine it co-developed with Pfizer.

records.title: Wells Fargo discloses customer data exposure via MOVEit file-transfer flaw
records.snippet: Wells Fargo said customer data was exposed through a vulnerability in the MOVEit file-transfer tool used by a third-party vendor.

records.title: Citigroup confirms breach through same MOVEit vulnerability
records.snippet: Citigroup confirmed attackers exploited the same MOVEit file-transfer flaw to access customer information.

records.title: Toyota recalls millions of vehicles over Takata airbag inflators
records.snippet: Toyota announced a recall of millions of vehicles worldwide to replace defective Takata airbag inflators.

records.title: Honda expands recall for same Takata airbag defect
records.snippet: Honda expanded its recall for the same Takata airbag inflator defect, adding hundreds of thousands of vehicles.

records.title: US revokes Qualcomm's export licenses to sell chips to Huawei
records.snippet: The US revoked certain export licenses that allowed Qualcomm to sell chips to Huawei.

records.title: Intel's Huawei export licenses revoked in same US action
records.snippet: Intel said the US Commerce Department revoked certain licenses for its exports to Huawei in the same action.

records.title: Exxon Mobil rallies as OPEC+ deepens voluntary output cuts
records.snippet: Exxon Mobil shares climbed after OPEC+ countries announced additional voluntary production cuts.

records.title: Chevron shares climb on same OPEC+ production decision
records.snippet: Chevron rose in tandem after the same OPEC+ decision to deepen voluntary output cuts boosted crude prices.

records.title: Uber reaches $175 million Massachusetts settlement over driver classification
records.snippet: Uber reached a $175 million settlement with Massachusetts over the classification of its drivers.

records.title: Lyft joins same Massachusetts driver-classification settlement
records.snippet: Lyft was part of the same $175 million Massachusetts settlement over gig-driver classification.

records.title: Google withdraws EU antitrust complaint against Microsoft cloud licensing
records.snippet: Google withdrew the antitrust complaint it had filed with the EU targeting Microsoft's cloud licensing practices.

records.title: Microsoft faces EU antitrust scrutiny over cloud licensing terms
records.snippet: EU regulators scrutinized Microsoft's cloud licensing terms following complaints from rivals about anti-competitive practices.

records.title: Apple beats quarterly estimates on strong iPhone sales
records.snippet: Apple reported quarterly revenue above analyst estimates, driven by stronger-than-expected iPhone demand in the holiday quarter.

records.title: Microsoft tops earnings estimates on cloud growth
records.snippet: Microsoft reported quarterly earnings that beat expectations, led by continued growth in its Azure cloud business.

records.title: Google launches Gemini 2.0 AI model
records.snippet: Google released Gemini 2.0, its latest AI model with expanded multimodal capabilities.

records.title: Meta debuts Llama 3 AI model
records.snippet: Meta introduced its Llama 3 generative AI model aimed at powering content creation and assistant features.

records.title: Nvidia faces chip packaging bottleneck for data-center GPUs
records.snippet: Nvidia said advanced chip packaging capacity constraints would limit shipments of its data-center GPUs.

records.title: Tesla delays deliveries citing automotive chip shortage
records.snippet: Tesla pushed back some vehicle deliveries, blaming a shortage of automotive-grade semiconductors.

records.title: JPMorgan to cut 2,000 back-office jobs in cost push
records.snippet: JPMorgan announced plans to eliminate about 2,000 back-office roles as part of an efficiency drive.

records.title: Goldman Sachs trims 1,500 roles in annual performance review
records.snippet: Goldman Sachs said it would cut about 1,500 employees as part of its routine annual performance review.

records.title: Amazon pays FTC settlement over Alexa children's privacy
records.snippet: Amazon agreed to pay a federal settlement over children's privacy violations involving Alexa.

records.title: SEC fines Tesla and Musk over 'funding secured' tweet
records.snippet: The SEC fined Tesla and CEO Elon Musk over his 'funding secured' tweet about taking the company private.

records.title: Merck's Keytruda wins FDA approval for lung cancer
records.snippet: The FDA approved Merck's Keytruda for adjuvant treatment of non-small cell lung cancer.

records.title: FDA approves Lilly's obesity drug Zepbound
records.snippet: The FDA approved Eli Lilly's once-weekly obesity treatment Zepbound for adults.

records.title: Apple unveils iPhone 16 with new camera system
records.snippet: Apple introduced the iPhone 16 featuring a redesigned camera system.

records.title: Google launches Pixel 9 flagship smartphone
records.snippet: Google launched its Pixel 9 flagship smartphone with a new Tensor processor.

records.title: Alphabet announces 20-for-1 stock split
records.snippet: Alphabet announced a 20-for-1 stock split intended to make shares more accessible to retail investors.

records.title: Amazon reveals 20-for-1 stock split plan
records.snippet: Amazon disclosed a 20-for-1 stock split, its first in more than two decades.

records.title: Microsoft raises quarterly dividend 10%
records.snippet: Microsoft announced a 10% increase in its quarterly dividend.

records.title: Coca-Cola boosts dividend for 62nd consecutive year
records.snippet: Coca-Cola raised its quarterly dividend, extending its streak of annual increases.

records.title: Starbucks to open 500 new China stores
records.snippet: Starbucks announced plans to open 500 new stores in China over the next two years.

records.title: McDonald's plans 400 new US locations
records.snippet: McDonald's said it would open 400 new restaurants in the United States this year.

records.title: Ford recalls F-150 trucks over brake line defect
records.snippet: Ford recalled hundreds of thousands of F-150 trucks to repair a potential brake line defect.

records.title: GM recalls EVs over battery pack issue
records.snippet: General Motors recalled some electric vehicles to address a battery pack issue that could cause power loss.

records.title: IBM and Oracle expand partnership on AI and hybrid cloud
records.snippet: IBM and Oracle announced an expanded partnership with new AI and hybrid cloud capabilities.

records.title: Oracle teams with Microsoft on database interoperability
records.snippet: Oracle and Microsoft announced a collaboration to improve interoperability between their database services.

same_ticker_duplicate.description: Two reports from different sources describing the same single-ticker story. Not a cross-ticker event.

records.title: Apple reports record Q3 services revenue
records.snippet: Apple reported record quarterly services revenue, led by App Store and subscription growth.

records.title: Apple posts record third-quarter services sales
records.snippet: Apple posted record services sales in the third quarter, driven by subscriptions and the App Store.

out_of_window.description: A record whose publication date falls outside the <=7 day look-back window and must be filtered out.

records.title: Nvidia unveils older generation gaming GPU
records.snippet: Nvidia introduced a previous-generation gaming GPU, announced weeks before the evaluation window.

no_data.description: No records available for the requested tickers; the run must report data_unavailable.

insufficient_evidence.description: A single-ticker record with no cross-ticker counterpart; must be left unmerged.

records.title: Tesla launches robotaxi service in Austin
records.snippet: Tesla launched a robotaxi ride-hailing service in Austin with no direct peer announcement matching the event.
